Fallback: Knights of the Ebon Blade

The Lich King dead (if he rose) and the Frozen Throne broken: his death knights are free. You play the Knights of the Ebon Blade -- Thassarian, Koltira, Nazgrim and Thoras Trollbane, no army -- with Acherus near Icecrown, sworn to whoever holds Icecrown Citadel. The rest of the Scourge is lost.
